'''May 2000 Meriden tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Meriden, Connecticut on 6 May 2000. [[Andy Klema]] won it. It is known from Andy Klema's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d682">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-meriden-connecticut-5-6-00d682/ meriden-connecticut-5-6-00], DeckTech (Andy "RexBanner7" Klema, 7 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-07-meriden-connecticut-5-6-00d682/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Meriden, Connecticut
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 22
* '''Winner:''' [[Andy Klema]]
